articles.title: A 7-Year-Old Bird Lover Meets His Scientist Hero in the Rain!
articles.summary: Khalib, 7, loves birds and wants to save the Earth. He got to go on a rainy bird walk with real scientist Keith Russell in Philadelphia. They talked about binoculars, blackbirds, and how to turn a dream into a job.

articles.title: UK's New Leader Says He'll Be 'Relentless' to Stop Small Boats
articles.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham promised to work hard to stop people crossing the English Channel in tiny, crowded boats. More than 2,000 have arrived since he took office two weeks ago. At least 84 died trying in 2024.

articles.title: No Rain, No Grain: Why Your Breakfast Cereal Might Get Pricier
articles.summary: Imagine fields so dry they crack like a broken cookie. That's happening in England and Wales right now. A big drought means farmers can't grow enough wheat, oats, and veggies. The head of the farmers' union says we could see food shortages and higher prices soon.
